title: Michael Jackson’s Biggest Fan Faces Off with Florida Cops
description:
A Florida woman was arrested after cranking up the volume on Michael Jackson’s "Thriller" while officers were conducting a traffic stop. According to the Lake County Sheriff’s Office, Faith Walker, 33, was pulled over after multiple reports of a reckless driver. But when officers arrived the suspect could be seen on body cameras singing and dancing before being forced out of her car. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
